config/content/names.th.json (dungeon.* entries carry a _preset field that must match one of presetIds.confirmed)
_meta._note: Preset definitions only. This file does not contain any dungeon instance (no polygon, no id, no zone_id). Every size, multiplier and drop-table value is a seeFile pointer into config/balance/, per CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 3 (no hardcoded balance numbers) and SF-8. This file is the authoritative source for dungeon preset ids (level-designer owns data/dungeons/*); it confirms the ids config/content/names.th.json proposed as ASSUMPTION A-P1-F03-T04-1.

presetIds._note: Confirmed by level-designer in this task. These 3 ids are the only values a dungeon record's preset field may hold. waterside is a second layer (see secondLayers below), not a 4th preset (D-049).

waterside.note: Not a 4th preset (D-049 accepted). A shape/theme layer that stacks on any of the 3 presets above when the polygon is a long, narrow shoreline or canal walk. Counted separately in launch-criteria.md presetDiversityScore (does not add to that formula's denominator of 3).
waterside.pendingConfigKey: coverageFilter.maxAspectRatio — proposed to systems-designer in design/levels/dungeon-rules.md section 12, not created yet. Until it exists, back office applies this layer by human judgement (long/narrow real-world shape), not by an automatic flag.

presetAssignmentRule._source: design/levels/presets.md section 2; design/levels/dungeon-rules.md section 12 (size band boundaries confirmed by level-designer)
presetAssignmentRule._note: Not read by any runtime pipeline. This is the rule this document used to sort the 741 real candidates in design/levels/presets.md section 4, and the default rule proposed for the F14 back office form (not yet planned) when a creator picks a preset for a new polygon.

realWorldSnapshot._note: Informational only. Not a Go/No-go count (that is P1-F01-T07). Recomputed by the validation script referenced in design/levels/presets.md section 12.

presets._source: GDD > พื้นที่เล่นและ Dungeon > การกำหนด dungeon ('สวนใหญ่'); design/levels/presets.md section 3; config/content/names.th.json#_meta.presetIds.largePark

labelKey._note: Internal back-office classification label only, not a player-facing string (CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 3 covers zone/dungeon/monster/item/boss names; a preset id is never shown to a player verbatim). The string a player sees is always the specific dungeon's own name_key (dungeon.<id> -> nameReal - nameSuffix in names.th.json), never this preset id. If a future back-office UI needs a translated dropdown label for the preset picker itself, that key belongs in config/content/copy.th.json (back-office namespace), not here — out of scope for this task.

areaRange_m2._note: Lower bound is exclusive in practice (size_band=medium starts just above sizeBandUpper_m2.small); the pipeline, not this file, owns the exact comparison.

suggestedLevelRange.rationale: design/levels/presets.md section 8: fewer and more central than pocketPark; the size_band=large landmark parks are a walk-farther, higher-level destination, size_band=medium ones can sit lower in this band.

smallDungeonMultiplier._note: Orthogonal to preset, not owned by it. design/levels/presets.md section 6: 105/216 real largePark candidates (49%) are below smallDungeonMaxArea_m2 and get the same rare-rate boost as pocketPark despite the preset label.

dropTable._note: v1 has one global drop table (rarity odds in baseChancePerRewardTick_pct, quantities, rewardTypeByRarity) plus the smallDungeon multiplier above. No preset-specific drop_table_id exists yet; a largePark dungeon record's drop_table_id resolves to this same file until systems-designer defines per-preset tables.

No monster mechanical config (HP/ATK/ids used by the combat/drop system) exists yet. A dungeon record's monster_roster_ids stays null/pending until that config lands.

openingHoursSource.caution: day-limited markets (e.g. weekend-only or Fri-Su evenings) are a PERMANENT dungeon of this preset with a restricted opening_hours string, not a temporaryDungeon (D-049). Do not set temporaryDungeon on a market just because it reads 'closed most days'. See workedExample_khlongOngAng below for a real candidate that is exactly this pattern.

suggestedLevelRange.rationale: design/levels/presets.md section 8: the largest and most evenly spread group (384/741, present in every province in section 4) — the near-home onboarding tier so a low-level dungeon within about 650 m is the common case.

smallDungeonMultiplier._note: Always applies for this preset: sizeBandUpper_m2.small (10,000) is below smallDungeonMaxArea_m2 (20,000), so every pocketPark candidate qualifies (384/384 in the real data).

dropTable._note: Same global drop table as every other preset in v1; see largePark entry for the shared caveat.

monsterTheme._note: Names and flavor only. See largePark entry for the same null-until-monster-config rule.

realWorldCoverage.note: design/levels/presets.md section 7 — 98.2% will be manual_required in practice; F14 should offer a sensible default choice for staff to pick, not leave the field blank.

whyStillWorthVisiting.note: A small dungeon nets +8.9% gold/hour (1,620 vs 1,488) because drops.json#multipliers.smallDungeonRareAndAboveMult (1.5x on riftStone-tier drops) outweighs smallDungeonCommonQuantityMult (0.6x on elementDust). Combined with CLAUDE.md non-negotiable 6 (high travel cost), the nearest pocketPark is not a downgrade from a distant largePark — it is the better hourly choice plus zero extra walk.

workedExample_khlongOngAng.levelDesignerFinding: The real OSM candidate is class=marketplace. Under presetAssignmentRule (this file), class == 'marketplace' always resolves to preset 'market', regardless of size_band. So the correct preset is 'market', not 'pocketPark'. The 'waterside' layer stays correct (it runs along the canal). This is also a clean real-world confirmation of design/levels/dungeon-rules.md sections 5 and 11: a walking-street market open only Fri-Su evenings is a PERMANENT dungeon with a day-limited opening_hours string, not a temporaryDungeon — the same pattern as ตลาดนัดจตุจักร under D-049.
